system.longDesc: You are relentless and overwhelming in melee combat.

degree0.desc: When you make a close combat attack, you can take up to a −3 penalty on your attack roll to receive a corresponding bonus to your damage roll.

degree1.desc: Your expertise makes you dangerous. When you succeed with a close combat attack, you can add your focus bonus for that attack to your damage total.

degree2.desc: You break through your opponent’s defense with brutal or relentless attacks. By spending 3 SP after a successful attack, your target must make an opposed Strength (Might) test against your attack roll. If they fail, they suffer a −2 penalty to Defense until the end of your next turn.
